missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Результат' is the masculine nominative subject. 'Хорошим' is the instrumental predicate after 'оказался'. A clean model for reporting outcomes.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. Inanimate 'результат' has an accusative identical to the nominative, here the direct object of 'получили'. 'Отличный' agrees in the masculine accusative. A common achievement statement.
Strategic focus: Genitive object. 'Результата' is the genitive governed by 'ждали', and 'экзамена' is the genitive of belonging. A natural anticipation pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Результату' is the dative governed by 'рады' (glad of). 'Такому' agrees in the masculine dative. A strong evaluation model.
Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Результатом' is the instrumental governed by 'доволен' (satisfied with). 'Своим' agrees in the masculine instrumental. A natural satisfaction model.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В этом результате' uses the prepositional 'результате' after 'в' to locate a flaw. 'Ошибка' is the nominative subject of 'есть'. A useful analytical pattern.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Результаты' is the accusative plural, the direct object of 'обсуждают'. 'Новые' agrees in the plural. A common academic collocation.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Результата' is the genitive required by 'нет'. 'Без труда' uses the genitive after 'без'. A proverbial cause-effect statement.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'К хорошему результату' uses the dative 'результату' after 'к', governed by 'привело'. 'Хорошему' agrees in the masculine dative. A core consequence pattern.
Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 'О результатах' uses the prepositional plural 'результатах' after 'о', and 'работы' is the genitive of belonging. A useful discussion frame.
